```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(R2jags)
library(coda)
library(patchwork)

main_path <- getwd()
data_path <- file.path(main_path, "data/cleaned_data")
study_1_path <- file.path(main_path, "study_1")
figure_path <- file.path(study_1_path, "figures")
models_path <- file.path(main_path, "models")
results_path <- file.path(main_path, "results")

set.seed(7386)

demographics <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "demographics.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
sound_events <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "sound_events.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
roundwise_clean <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "roundwise_clean.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

source(file.path(main_path, "overall_functions.R"))
```

## Identify the no-press dyads

```{r}
# Full analytic Study 1 sample
dem_coop_analytic <- demographics %>%
  filter(
    !excluded,
    setup == "COOP")

analytic_coop_ids <- dem_coop_analytic %>%
  distinct(id)

sound_coop_analytic <- sound_events %>%
  filter(setup == "COOP") %>%
  semi_join(analytic_coop_ids, by = "id")

# Dyads in which neither participant pressed during any sound event
no_press_dyads <- sound_coop_analytic %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_female_presses = sum(
      responder_gender == "Female",
      na.rm = TRUE),
    n_male_presses = sum(
      responder_gender == "Male",
      na.rm = TRUE),
    n_no_press_events = sum(
      responder_gender == "none",
      na.rm = TRUE),
    n_presses = n_female_presses + n_male_presses,
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n_presses == 0)

no_press_dyads
nrow(no_press_dyads)
```

```{r}
# Participants and rounds from the no-press dyads
dem_no_press <- dem_coop_analytic %>%
  semi_join(no_press_dyads, by = "id")

no_press_rounds <- roundwise_clean %>%
  filter(
    !excluded,
    setup == "COOP") %>%
  semi_join(no_press_dyads, by = "id")
```

## Derive performance and sound variables

```{r}
no_press_rounds <- no_press_rounds %>%
  mutate(
    gender = factor(
      gender,
      levels = c("Female", "Male")),
    completed = as.integer(completed),
    success = as.integer(success),
    skipped = as.integer(completed == 0),
    secs = as.numeric(secs),
    log_secs = log(secs + 1),
    n_sound_episodes = replace_na(n_sound_episodes, 0),
    any_sound = as.integer(
      replace_na(any_stimulus, FALSE))) %>%
  mutate(
    sound1_lower = str_to_lower(
      coalesce(sound1_stimulus, "")),
    sound2_lower = str_to_lower(
      coalesce(sound2_stimulus, "")),
    sound3_lower = str_to_lower(
      coalesce(sound3_stimulus, "")),
    any_cry = as.integer(
      str_detect(sound1_lower, "cry|cries") |
        str_detect(sound2_lower, "cry|cries") |
        str_detect(sound3_lower, "cry|cries")),
    any_alarm = as.integer(
      str_detect(sound1_lower, "alarm") |
        str_detect(sound2_lower, "alarm") |
        str_detect(sound3_lower, "alarm")),
    round_sound_type = case_when(
      any_sound == 0 ~ "none",
      any_cry == 1 & any_alarm == 0 ~ "cry_only",
      any_cry == 0 & any_alarm == 1 ~ "alarm_only",
      any_cry == 1 & any_alarm == 1 ~ "mixed_cry_alarm",
      TRUE ~ "unclear"),
    round_sound_type = factor(
      round_sound_type,
      levels = c(
        "none",
        "alarm_only",
        "cry_only",
        "mixed_cry_alarm",
        "unclear")))

# Retain the sound conditions represented in the no-press dyads
# Exclude mixed cry-alarm rounds
no_press_rounds <- no_press_rounds %>%
  filter(round_sound_type != "mixed_cry_alarm")
```

## Participant-level task-performance descriptives

```{r}
no_press_participant_performance <- no_press_rounds %>%
  group_by(
    id,
    participant.code,
    gender) %>%
  summarise(
    n_matrices_seen = n(),
    n_matrices_completed = sum(
      completed,
      na.rm = TRUE),
    n_matrices_correct = sum(
      success,
      na.rm = TRUE),
    n_matrices_skip = sum(
      skipped,
      na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_round_duration_secs = mean(
      secs,
      na.rm = TRUE),
    n_rounds_with_any_sound = sum(
      any_sound,
      na.rm = TRUE),
    n_rounds_with_more_than_one_sound = sum(
      n_sound_episodes > 1,
      na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop")

no_press_participant_performance %>%
  summarise(
    n_participants = n(),

    mean_matrices_seen =
      mean(n_matrices_seen, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_matrices_seen =
      sd(n_matrices_seen, na.rm = TRUE),

    mean_matrices_completed =
      mean(n_matrices_completed, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_matrices_completed =
      sd(n_matrices_completed, na.rm = TRUE),

    mean_matrices_correct =
      mean(n_matrices_correct, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_matrices_correct =
      sd(n_matrices_correct, na.rm = TRUE),

    mean_matrices_skip =
      mean(n_matrices_skip, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_matrices_skip =
      sd(n_matrices_skip, na.rm = TRUE),

    round_duration_mean =
      mean(mean_round_duration_secs, na.rm = TRUE),
    round_duration_sd =
      sd(mean_round_duration_secs, na.rm = TRUE),

    mean_rounds_with_any_sound =
      mean(n_rounds_with_any_sound, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_rounds_with_any_sound =
      sd(n_rounds_with_any_sound, na.rm = TRUE),

    mean_rounds_with_more_than_one_sound =
      mean(
        n_rounds_with_more_than_one_sound,
        na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_rounds_with_more_than_one_sound =
      sd(
        n_rounds_with_more_than_one_sound,
        na.rm = TRUE))

no_press_participant_performance %>%
  group_by(gender) %>%
  summarise(
    n_participants = n(),

    mean_matrices_seen =
      mean(n_matrices_seen, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_matrices_seen =
      sd(n_matrices_seen, na.rm = TRUE),

    mean_matrices_completed =
      mean(n_matrices_completed, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_matrices_completed =

    mean_matrices_correct =
      mean(n_matrices_correct, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_matrices_correct =

    mean_matrices_skip =
      mean(n_matrices_skip, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_matrices_skip =

      mean(mean_round_duration_secs, na.rm = TRUE),
```

## Paired gender comparisons of participant-level performance

```{r}
no_press_performance_wide <- no_press_participant_performance %>%
  dplyr::select(
    id,
    gender,
    n_matrices_seen,
    n_matrices_completed,
    n_matrices_correct,
    mean_round_duration_secs) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = gender,
    values_from = c(
      n_matrices_seen,
      n_matrices_completed,
      n_matrices_correct,
      mean_round_duration_secs))

no_press_difference_scores <- no_press_performance_wide %>%
  transmute(
    id,
    matrices_seen_diff =
      n_matrices_seen_Female -
      n_matrices_seen_Male,
    matrices_answered_diff =
      n_matrices_completed_Female -
      n_matrices_completed_Male,
    matrices_correct_diff =
      n_matrices_correct_Female -
      n_matrices_correct_Male,
    mean_duration_diff =
      mean_round_duration_secs_Female -
      mean_round_duration_secs_Male)

no_press_difference_scores_long <-
  no_press_difference_scores %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -id,
    names_to = "outcome",
    values_to = "difference") %>%
  mutate(
    outcome = factor(
      outcome,
      levels = c(
        "matrices_seen_diff",
        "matrices_answered_diff",
        "matrices_correct_diff",
        "mean_duration_diff"),
      labels = c(
        "Matrices seen",
        "Matrices answered",
        "Matrices correct",
        "Mean round duration")))
```

```{r}
# Distributional checks of within-dyad difference scores
# Boxplots of within-dyad difference scores
p_no_press_difference_boxplots <-
  ggplot(
    no_press_difference_scores_long,
    aes(
      x = "",
      y = difference)) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = 2,
    linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.45,
    outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.08,
    height = 0,
    alpha = 0.70,
    size = 1.8) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ outcome,
    scales = "free_y",
    ncol = 2) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Female − male difference") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank())

plot_png_path <- file.path(figure_path, "s1_no_press_difference_boxplots.png")

show_or_save_ggplot(
  plot_png_path = plot_png_path,
  plot_object = p_no_press_difference_boxplots,
  width = 9,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 300)

# Q-Q plots of within-dyad difference scores
p_no_press_difference_qq <-
  ggplot(
    no_press_difference_scores_long,

    linewidth = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ outcome,
    scales = "free",
```

```{r}
  no_press_difference_scores$matrices_correct_diff)

```

```{r}
# Paired-samples t-tests
t.test(
  no_press_performance_wide$n_matrices_seen_Female,
  no_press_performance_wide$n_matrices_seen_Male,
  paired = TRUE)

t.test(
  no_press_performance_wide$n_matrices_completed_Female,
  no_press_performance_wide$n_matrices_completed_Male,
  paired = TRUE)

t.test(
  no_press_performance_wide$n_matrices_correct_Female,
  no_press_performance_wide$n_matrices_correct_Male,
  paired = TRUE)

t.test(
  no_press_performance_wide$mean_round_duration_secs_Female,
  no_press_performance_wide$mean_round_duration_secs_Male,
```

## Duration model fitted to answered rounds

```{r}
duration_data <- no_press_rounds %>%
  filter(
    completed == 1,
    round_sound_type %in% c(
      "none",
      "cry_only"),
    !is.na(log_secs),
    !is.na(gender),
    !is.na(participant.code),
    !is.na(id)) %>%
  droplevels() %>%
  mutate(
    gender = relevel(
      gender,
      ref = "Female"),
    round_sound_type = relevel(
      round_sound_type,
      ref = "none"))

duration_data %>%
  count(
    gender,
    round_sound_type)

duration_data %>%
  summarise(
    n_rounds = n(),
    n_dyads = n_distinct(id),
    n_participants =
      n_distinct(participant.code))
```

```{r}
# Raw and log-transformed duration distributions
duration_dist_df <- duration_data %>%
```

```{r}
samples_path <- file.path(results_path, "s1_jags_no_press_duration.rds")

if (file.exists(samples_path)) {

  samples_duration <- readRDS(samples_path)

} else {

  samples_duration <- jags.parallel(
    data = data_list_duration,
    inits = NULL,
    parameters.to.save = params_duration,
    model.file = file.path(
      models_path,
      "s1_no_press_duration.bugs"),
    n.chains = 12,
    n.iter = 25000,
    n.burnin = 5000,
    n.thin = 1)

  saveRDS(
    samples_duration,
    samples_path)
}

samples_duration

s1_no_press_samples <- samples_duration

s1_no_press_draws <- as.matrix(
  as.mcmc(s1_no_press_samples))
```

```{r}
# Trace plots for Bayesian no-press duration model

mcmc_list_duration <- as.mcmc(samples_duration)

trace_parameters <- c(
  "b0",
  "b_gender",
  "b_cry",
  "b_cry_gender",
  "gender_diff_cry",
  "sigma_participant",
  "sigma_dyad",
  "sigma")

trace_df_duration <- purrr::map2_dfr(
  mcmc_list_duration,
  seq_along(mcmc_list_duration),
  ~ as.data.frame(.x) %>%
    rownames_to_column("iteration") %>%
    mutate(
      iteration = as.integer(iteration),
      chain = paste0("chain_", .y))) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    iteration,
    chain,
    all_of(trace_parameters)) %>%
  group_by(chain) %>%
  slice(seq(1, n(), by = 20)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(trace_parameters),
    names_to = "parameter",
    values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(
    parameter = factor(
      parameter,
      levels = trace_parameters,
      labels = c(
        "Intercept",
        "Male versus female",
        "Infant cry versus no sound",
        "Infant cry × male",
        "Female-male difference in cry effect",
        "Participant SD",
        "Dyad SD",
        "Residual SD")))

p_duration_trace <- ggplot(
  trace_df_duration,
  aes(
    x = iteration,
    y = value,
    colour = chain)) +
  geom_line(
    alpha = 0.60,
    linewidth = 0.25) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ parameter,
    scales = "free_y",
    ncol = 2) +
  labs(
    x = "Iteration",
    y = "Parameter value",
    colour = "Chain") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))

plot_png_path <- file.path(figure_path, "s1_no_press_duration_bayesian_traceplots.png")

show_or_save_ggplot(
  plot_png_path = plot_png_path,
  plot_object = p_duration_trace,
  width = 11,
  height = 10,
  dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

plot_png_path <- file.path(figure_path, "s1_no_press_duration_gender_difference_prior_posterior.png")

show_or_save_ggplot(
  plot_png_path = plot_png_path,
  plot_object = p_duration_prior_post,
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
s11_extra <- tibble(
  parameter = c(
    "b_cry",
    "b_gender",
    "b_cry_gender"),
  prior_parameter = c(
    "b_cry_prior",
    "b_gender_prior",
    "b_cry_gender_prior")) %>%
  mutate(
    extra = map2(
      parameter,
      prior_parameter,
      function(parameter, prior_parameter) {

        posterior_draws <- s1_no_press_draws[, parameter]
        prior_draws <- s1_no_press_draws[, prior_parameter]

        p_positive <- mean(posterior_draws > 0)
        p_negative <- mean(posterior_draws < 0)

        if (p_positive >= p_negative) {
          posterior_probability <- p_positive
          direction <- "> 0"
        } else {
          posterior_probability <- p_negative
          direction <- "< 0"
        }

        ER <- posterior_probability /
          (1 - posterior_probability)

        d_post <- density(posterior_draws)
        d_prior <- density(prior_draws)

        post_at_0 <- approx(
          d_post$x,
          d_post$y,
          xout = 0)$y

        prior_at_0 <- approx(
          d_prior$x,
          d_prior$y,
          xout = 0)$y

        BF01 <- post_at_0 / prior_at_0

        tibble(
          direction = direction,
          posterior_probability = posterior_probability,
          ER = ER,
          BF01 = BF01)
      })) %>%
  unnest(extra)

s11_extra
```

Visualisation
--------------
```{r}
gender_colours <- c(
  "Female" = "#2A9D8F", 
  "Male" = "#eb8005")

# Participant-level observed mean log durations
duration_participant_means <- duration_data %>%
  group_by(
    participant.code,
    gender,
    round_sound_type) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_log_secs = mean(
      log_secs,
      na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    gender = factor(
      gender,
      levels = c(
        "Female",
        "Male")),
    round_sound_type = factor(
      round_sound_type,
      levels = c(
        "none",
        "cry_only"),
      labels = c(
        "No sound",
        "Infant cry")))
```

```{r}
panel_a_parameters <- tibble(
  parameter = c(
    "mean_none_female",
    "mean_cry_female",
    "mean_none_male",
    "mean_cry_male"),
  gender = c(
    "Female",
    "Female",
    "Male",
    "Male"),
  round_sound_type = c(
    "No sound",
    "Infant cry",
    "No sound",
    "Infant cry"))

panel_a_summary <- panel_a_parameters %>%
  mutate(
    mean = map_dbl(
      parameter,
      ~ mean(s1_no_press_draws[, .x])),
    lower = map_dbl(
      parameter,
      ~ quantile(
        s1_no_press_draws[, .x],
        .025)),
    upper = map_dbl(
      parameter,
      ~ quantile(
        s1_no_press_draws[, .x],
        .975)),
    gender = factor(
      gender,
      levels = c(
        "Female",
        "Male")),
    round_sound_type = factor(
      round_sound_type,
      levels = c(
        "No sound",
        "Infant cry")))
```


```{r}
duration_dodge <- position_dodge(width = .78)

p_panel_a <- ggplot(
  duration_participant_means,
  aes(
    x = round_sound_type,
    y = mean_log_secs,
    fill = gender,
    colour = gender)) +
  geom_violin(
    aes(
      group = interaction(
        round_sound_type,
        gender)),
    position = duration_dodge,
    width = .70,
    scale = "width",
    trim = FALSE,
    alpha = .10,
    linewidth = .55) +
  geom_point(
    position = position_jitterdodge(
      jitter.width = .07,
      jitter.height = 0,
      dodge.width = .78),
    size = 1.7,
    alpha = .40) +
  geom_errorbar(
    data = panel_a_summary,
    aes(
      x = round_sound_type,
      ymin = lower,
      ymax = upper,
      colour = gender),
    position = duration_dodge,
    width = .10,
    linewidth = .9,
    inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_point(
    data = panel_a_summary,
    aes(
      x = round_sound_type,
      y = mean,
      colour = gender),
    position = duration_dodge,
    size = 3.2,
    inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = gender_colours) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = gender_colours) +
  labs(
    title = "A.",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Log-transformed answered-round duration",
    fill = NULL,
    colour = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top")
```


```{r}
panel_b_parameters <- tibble(
  parameter = c(
    "cry_vs_none_female",
    "cry_vs_none_male"),
  gender = c(
    "Female",
    "Male"))

panel_b_summary <- panel_b_parameters %>%
  mutate(
    mean = map_dbl(
      parameter,
      ~ mean(s1_no_press_draws[, .x])),
    lower = map_dbl(
      parameter,
      ~ quantile(
        s1_no_press_draws[, .x],
        .025)),
    upper = map_dbl(
      parameter,
      ~ quantile(
        s1_no_press_draws[, .x],
        .975)),
    gender = factor(
      gender,
      levels = c(
        "Female",
        "Male")),
    contrast = "Infant cry versus no sound")

p_panel_b <- ggplot(
  panel_b_summary,
  aes(
    x = mean,
    y = contrast,
    colour = gender)) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = 2,
    linewidth = .7) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      xmin = lower,
      xmax = upper),
    position = position_dodge(
      width = .45),
    width = 0,
    linewidth = .9,
    orientation = "y") +
  geom_point(
    position = position_dodge(
      width = .45),
    size = 3.2) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = gender_colours) +
  labs(
    title = "B.",
    x = "Estimated difference in log-transformed round duration",
    y = "Infant cry versus no sound",
    colour = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank())
```
